execute_start_barrier: After this protocol and the exact pending Candidate response are main-readback verified, consume Candidate once and publish/bind the frozen Execute request before readiness observations.

issue.selection: Get current issue count, compute final page with per_page20; if final page has fewer than20, combine final and penultimate page and retain latest20 in ascending id order. Retain only non-secret readiness-relevant facts and source ids/timestamps.

workflows.selection: List current-main workflow filenames; case-insensitive filename matches live|provider|copilot|campaign, lexicographic path ascending, first at most3. Fetch only those definitions, workflow metadata and latest at most5 runs per workflow sorted API newest first. If no matching workflow, report absence only within this exact directory/version and selector.

capabilities.filter: Work/O execution, provider status/readiness/capacity or workflow read APIs

decision_rule.independent_evaluator: Only explicit fresh independently controlled evaluator identity/access or external attestation can change unknown/unavailable-to-this-route status; a request/self-attestation is not evidence.
decision_rule.provider: Historical quota failure cannot establish current capacity; without a fresh non-secret account/provider capacity signal, current capacity remains unknown. Workflow success alone does not prove paid quota or provider inference availability.
decision_rule.next_route: Select one concrete safe no-paid/no-new-primary falsifiable successor from actual observations. If external evaluator/provider prerequisites are still unmet, select an independently executable local or public-data behavioral protocol with explicit bounded claim scope; no replay of the six prior planning trials.
decision_rule.queue: Preserve both existing IDs, status/nonblocking semantics and prior review/history; update review evidence/reevaluate fields with expected revision1 plus latest observed blob/head checks. Stop stale publication on conflict and reread.
decision_rule.claim_boundary: Readiness review is internal operational evidence; upper objective remains open/FAIL, AGI false.

recurrence: Source change before use invalidates affected observations; unavailable reads stay unknown. After publication evaluate the exact evidence, not repeated searches.
